Prospective MSE Graduate Students
Thank you for your interest in the Materials Science & Engineering Department here at the University of Utah! We are thrilled that you are considering our program, university and beautiful state. Utah is a pretty great place to live, visit and learn.
Please take the time to explore our four graduate programs -- Ph.D. in Materials Science & Engineering, Ph.D. in Metallurgical Engineering, M.S. in Materials Science & Engineering and M.S. in Metallurgical Engineering. Please explore this page for more information on faculty members currently recruiting members for their research groups, with over 20+ full-time faculty members you're sure to find a discipline suited specifically to you.
If you have further questions please reach out to our Graduate Academic Advisor.
Click each icon for information about our academic programs
Faculty Research Group Recruitment
The Materials Science & Engineering Department at the University of Utah currently has 20+ faculty members over two accredited programs, Materials Science & Engineering and Metallurgical Engineering. Many of our faculty lead research groups of research professors, post-doc fellows and Ph.D., M.S. and undergraduate students. The following professors are currently recruiting group members for the 2024-25 academic year.
Please feel free to reach out to the professors for more information about their groups, research and funding opportunities.
